image.description: The contributor visual representation as a URI or image blob.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

identifier.description: DID (did:plc:...) or URI to a social profile of the contributor.

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.

displayName.description: Human-readable name for the contributor as it should appear in UI.

main.description: Contributor information including identifier, display name, and image.
